title: Hag's Ring

sources.title: Vicious Mockery
markers: | summary = It deals Psychic damage to enemies and inflicts Disadvantage on their Attack Rolls.

summary: Cast Vicious Mockery while wearing the ring.

fields.Vicious Mockery: Action, 60 ft, Wisdom save against your spell save DC negates. On failure deal 1d4 Psychic, rising to 2d4 at character level 5 and 3d4 at level 10. The target has disadvantage on its next attack roll within 1 turn. Some targeted actions consume the condition without an attack roll.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
